name: AT_WEST_LAKES_BOULEVARD_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. R9-SA53-2A (450 x 450) illustrated (B 600, C 750 in the table), R50, 6 / 18. AT 45 E (183/83/184); road name three lines 50 'E>C' (Series E preferred, reduce to C where too wide, max. dimension 360). Sheet: '= offset' top/bottom and '= gap' between lines: resolved on the drawing itself — AT top 60, name lines top 150 / 245 / 340 (offset 60, gap 45; 60+45+45+50+45+50+45+50+60 = 450). Road name WEST LAKES BOULEVARD is the sheet's example ('Road Name is an example only', drawn in grey); drawn here in black as the sign would read. BOULEVARD at 50 E measures 374 on the sheet, over the stated 360 max — the sheet's own example exceeds its rule; kept in E. Only used with R2-6.
